# proxmox_notification_endpoint_sendmail (Resource)

Manages the local sendmail notification target through `/cluster/notifications/endpoints/sendmail`. The built-in `mail-to-root` target can be managed by importing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_notification_endpoint_sendmail" "ops" {
  name   = "ops-mail"
  mailto = ["ops@example.test"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable endpoint name (`pve-configid`). Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `author` (String) Author shown in the mail.
- `body` (String) Request body template.
- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target.
- `from_address` (String) Sender address.
- `header` (Set of String) HTTP header property strings such as `Authorization=Bearer x`.
- `mailto` (Set of String) Recipient addresses.
- `mailto_user` (Set of String) Recipient Proxmox users.
- `method` (String) HTTP method: `post`, `put` or `get`.
- `mode` (String) TLS mode: `insecure`, `starttls` or `tls`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP authentication password. Not returned by Proxmox.
- `port` (Number) SMTP port. Proxmox defaults to 25 without TLS and 465 with TLS.
- `secret` (Set of String, Sensitive) `name=<header>,value=<base64 value>` entries to redact in the Proxmox UI; Proxmox echoes only the names back.
- `server` (String) Server hostname, IP or URL.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Gotify application token. Not returned by Proxmox.
- `url` (String) Webhook URL (`http://` or `https://`).
- `username` (String) SMTP authentication user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Endpoint name.
